title: Email and messaging
purpose: When first buyers are not coming back, the email number looks too good, or a send goes wrong, open Email and messaging to turn subscribers and first buyers into repeat orders, counted from real orders, without spam or consent risk.
fires: the email platform's own revenue dashboard, the agency's monthly deck, the weekly discount blast, the Sunday night writing session, and never checking flows once they are live
not_for: a store with under about 1,000 subscribers or under 100 orders a month, where a welcome and a cart flow set up once are enough

jobs.job: When I paid $40 to win a first-time buyer and most never order again, get them to a second order within 90 days, so I make the ad cost pay back
jobs.circumstance: month end, new customers up from ads, repeat rate flat at 22 percent, the post-purchase emails are the platform's default template

progress.functional: a post-purchase sequence that brings a second order from first-time buyers
progress.emotional: stop feeling each new customer is a one-night stand the ads paid for
progress.social: show a partner or investor that customers come back

jobs.hire_today: an email agency, or the platform's default post-purchase flow
jobs.fire: the default template and the hope that buyers return on their own

forces.push: every first-time buyer who never returns makes the ad spend a loss
forces.pull: first-to-second order messages timed to how buyers of each product reorder, judged on store orders
forces.habit: we send a thank-you email and a discount
forces.anxiety: what if more emails push buyers to unsubscribe

jobs.little_hire: monthly, and when a new product brings a wave of first-time buyers

watch.metric: share of first-time buyers who order again within 90 days

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 22 percent of first-time buyers order again in 90 days. After: 28 percent within 2 quarters.
jobs.not_for: a store with under 100 orders a month, or a product bought once in a lifetime

progress.functional: flow and campaign revenue counted from store orders, next to the platform's claim

jobs.hire_today: the agency's word and the platform's dashboard; checking by hand means joining 2 exports nobody has time for

forces.push: the agency fee and the tool fee are paid on a number nobody checked

forces.anxiety: what if the real number makes email look weak and I cut something that works

watch.metric: flow revenue matched to store orders against platform-reported revenue, trailing 30 days
